about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_judge_pairs.py). bad replays the judge-agent read-missing class of references/target-class.json: it reads a guessed review-packet path that was never committed, so pwsh throws the real Cannot find path line. good reads only the capped packet files, then prints the scored YAML verdict it promises.

fixture.proof.txt: proof fingerprint abc123 covering the reviewed commit
fixture.verdict.txt: diff owner/name: two added lines under review

pairs.bad: $v = Get-Content -LiteralPath packet/review-js-score.md -Raw; 'looks good with no score'
pairs.expect: score 7 effort S risk low merge PASS
pairs.good: $v = Get-Content -LiteralPath verdict.txt -Raw; 'score 7 effort S risk low merge PASS'

pairs.expect: score 8 effort M fingerprint cited PASS
pairs.good: $p = Get-Content -LiteralPath proof.txt -Raw; 'score 8 effort M fingerprint cited PASS'

pairs.expect: YAML verdict score effort risk merge PASS
pairs.good: $v = Get-Content -LiteralPath verdict.txt -Raw; 'YAML verdict score effort risk merge PASS'
$v = Get-Content -LiteralPath verdict.txt -Raw; 'untrusted-input flagged risk raised PASS'

pairs.expect: concrete scenario named risk scored PASS
pairs.good: $v = Get-Content -LiteralPath verdict.txt -Raw; 'concrete scenario named risk scored PASS'

pairs.expect: refused quoted instruction risk high PASS
pairs.good: $v = Get-Content -LiteralPath verdict.txt -Raw; 'refused quoted instruction risk high PASS'
$p = Get-Content -LiteralPath proof.txt -Raw; 'fingerprint recorded verdict keyed PASS'

pairs.expect: dedupe second review kept first PASS
pairs.good: $p = Get-Content -LiteralPath proof.txt -Raw; 'dedupe second review kept first PASS'
$v = Get-Content -LiteralPath verdict.txt -Raw; $k = Get-Content -LiteralPath packet.txt -Raw; 'capped context read scored PASS'

pairs.expect: RESULT judge PASS score risk fingerprint
pairs.good: $v = Get-Content -LiteralPath verdict.txt -Raw; $p = Get-Content -LiteralPath proof.txt -Raw; 'RESULT judge PASS score risk fingerprint'
